title: OULAD preprocessing
summary: A preprocessing and analysis pipeline for the Open University Learning Analytics Dataset (OULAD) that builds student datasets, trains ML classifiers, and statistically compares real vs. synthetic data conclusions (e.g., Fisher exact tests). SDV's SingleTableMetadata and evaluation functions (evaluate_quality, run_diagnostic) are called directly to assess the quality of the synthetic student data.
